title: Level Arc
description: Machine-readable level arc (lesson-plans/{level}/_arc.yaml), generated from docs/epics/fresh-build-{level}-arc.md by scripts/curriculum/arc/generate_arc.py. Never edited by hand.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the arc document this file was generated from

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the arc document bytes at generation time; loaders must re-verify it

est_lessons_total.description: Sum of all positions' est_lessons; the generator checks it equals the lesson total stated in the arc document's sizing paragraph

slug.description: Module slug (backticks from the document stripped)

est_lessons.description: Estimated lessons including the recap (sizing estimate; the module plan decides)

job.description: One-sentence job of the module, verbatim from the document

inventory_text.description: Literacy inventory cell, verbatim; null for main-table positions

skills_text.description: Skills duty cell, verbatim from the document

skills.description: Parsed skills duty codes: W writing, Li listening, R real-world reading

standard_line_refs.description: Backticked :NNN / :NNN-NNN references into the State Standard document, as [start, end] pairs in order of appearance

letters.description: Letters introduced by a literacy position (key omitted on main-table positions)
